audit_kind: independent static review plus separately tested layout component
parser_findings: Input fields are positive integers <=500000. No sign support is required.
fread returns at most65536 bytes so int len is safe. cur==len refill occurs before any buffer access.
The digit loop continues across refills and preserves a number ending exactly at EOF. Delimiters are consumed intentionally.
Only ASCII digits and whitespace occur, so signed-char return cannot alias EOF.
Malformed or truncated input returns0, outside problem guarantee; no malformed-input behavior claimed.
layout_findings: Stable record partition fills both destination ranges completely before either recursion.
Sibling calls use disjoint position ranges in both alternating arrays. A child may overwrite the old parent buffer, which the parent no longer reads.
Same-rank leaf sets s=p before scanning, avoiding an unwritten destination buffer. Single-record leaf also uses the current source.
Query id is copied with each record; ok is indexed by current query position and consumed before recursion.
Initial counting sorts copy from buffer0 to buffer1; rank conversion is complete before tmp is reused.
The y-tree and touched capacities, recursion bounds and no-pushdown reasoning are unchanged from reviewed v2.
combined_runtime_validation: Reported separately by independent-core-layout-io testing agent; this static report does not claim those tests passed.
